requirement: V3-20/T: long-silence quality-control inspection through the existing audio production owner
scope: Read-only inspection of one selected existing complete.json and its verified retained PCM/timeline. Findings are review warnings, not render failure or acoustic-quality acceptance.

api.signature: (manifest_path, *, threshold_dbfs, minimum_seconds, expected_run_key=None, cancelled=lambda: False, on_status=lambda message: None, max_intervals=1000)
api.criterion: For every frame, every PCM16 channel's absolute integer sample is at or below floor(32768*10**(threshold_dbfs/20)). Minimum frames are the ceiling of the displayed decimal seconds times the actual PCM sample rate.
api.frames: Maximal half-open start-inclusive/end-exclusive intervals. The complete PCM is scanned; capped rows do not truncate total qualifying-span/frame counts.
api.errors: ValueError for invalid criteria/recorded context or unverified completion; existing RuntimeError/_CompletedOutputInvalid and local I/O errors for changed/invalid media; existing jobs.RenderCancelled for explicit cancellation.

ownership.processes: No engine, decoder, FFmpeg process, model, output device, queue or resource-store creation.
ownership.filesystem: No completion, plan, cache, original, journal or directory mutation by inspection.
ownership.hashes: Initial shared completion verification; complete/timeline raw SHA bindings; complete master raw SHA during header+PCM+trailing-byte streaming; final complete/timeline rehash; retained native change-time/identity checks before return.
ownership.historical_compatibility: Existing render/replay/publication bodies and serialized schemas/run identities are unchanged. Inspection requires existing source/plan/run bindings and never fabricates or writes a missing historical binding.
ownership.memory: PCM blocks at most1MiB plus one bounded sample array; retained intervals<=1000. Complete/timeline JSON retain existing16MiB non-hardlinked reader budgets. Context records<=100000, merged/sorted once; report annotations have three aggregate numeric overlap-frame fields, not event lists or source text.
ownership.recorded_context: Only retained Pause, Line and explicitly music-tagged clip ranges annotate findings. Scene background music is not recorded in the existing timeline and remains explicitly unknown. Overlap does not prove intent or acoustic content.
ownership.handoff: UI/CLI integration is separately owned. Later report export must retain its own selected-source approval/binding; no export implementation is included in this component.

coverage: Actual PCM crosses the real1MiB block boundary in mono/stereo.
All-channel signed PCM threshold and exact minimum-frame boundaries, including0dBFS and exact-zero thresholds.
Interval cap retains complete counts and qualifying frames.
Nonfinite/bool/out-of-range settings refuse before file admission.
Actual producer Pause/Line/music-clip context and bounded aggregate report over2400 recorded events; no inference/runtime/cache path.
Changed retained PCM/timeline/completion refusal and actual Windows sharing/POSIX identity mutation attempts while held.
Before/during cancellation leaves all retained bytes unchanged.
Expected-run/manifest selection and resealed malformed timeline refusal.
Historical completed replay still reuses its bytes; pre-existing journal-refresh behavior is retained.
Formatter bounds and forged count/annotation/criterion refusal.
tests.execution: NOT_RUN: no local executor. Current protected module requires the selected existing FFmpeg runtime; root will run meaningful source/installed and native qualification on the composed successor.

limitations: No automatic PASS/FAIL judgment of acoustic quality, speech accuracy, voice identity or language support.
No prediction that a recorded pause or music overlap means silence was intended.
No new CUE/EDL dialect, ASR quality checker, waveform editor or duplicate framework.
No refs/PRs/workflows launched; current c31 execution remains unchanged.
